                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/claims">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ClaimHandlingProceeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Examine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Examine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Examine_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Examine_Write</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotOK_Write</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimOK" name="Claim marked OK?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OK_Proceed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotOK_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ClaimHandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OK_Proceed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Examine" sourceRef="Start_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Examine_Write" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Write_Check" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OK_Proceed" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOK" targetRef="End_ClaimHandlingProceeds">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOK_Write" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOK" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'Not OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
